criteria.text: Calculates the long-stop date as 28 September 2026 (150 days after signing on 1 May 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 28 October 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 25 December 2027 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 25 June 2029 (36 months after Closing).

Identifies the threatened $3,400,000 claim by Juniper Pharma plc recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Gives the long-stop period as 150 days and as the date 28 September 2026, with days remaining from 21 May 2026 (130 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
